title: Solutions stable outside a compact set for anisotropic quasilinear equations with negative exponent or exponential nonlinearity
summary:
We study the equations $Δ_p^H u=u^{-q}$, $u>0$, and $-Δ_p^H u=e^u$ in $\mathbb{R}^N$, where $Δ_p^H u=\operatorname{div}(H(
abla u)^{p-1}
abla H(
abla u))$ is the Finsler $p$-Laplacian associated with a uniformly convex norm $H$, and $p\ge2$. We prove nonexistence of solutions stable outside a compact set for the negative-power equation when $p\le N qτ$, where $τ= rac{p}{q+p-1}$, a positive exterior solution of $Δ_p^H u=u^{-q}$ cannot remain above $θ$ times the singular solution near infinity for any $θ>1$.
